_about: Claude API list prices in $ per million tokens: [input, output, cache read]. Read by `cld usage` and agent-top. Source: the claude-api skill's model table, cached 2026-10-06. Where it names no cache-read price, the standard 0.1x input is used. Cache writes bill input x cache_write_5m or x cache_write_1h; fast mode bills x fast. Not modelled: Haiku 5.5's higher price past 100K-token prompts. A model id matches the longest key it equals or extends with '-' (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 -> claude-haiku-4-5).
